candidates.name: Phototoxic Maculopathy
support_spans: directed an online-bought handheld high-intensity LED light (30 chip-on-board LEDs emitting 5 W, 100 lm/W at 500 mA) at her right eye multiple times at very short distance with flash mode

candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and OCT findings are consistent with phototoxic maculopathy caused by high-intensity LED light exposure.
